NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: AMOLED Dark Theme
patches.description: Makes the dark theme pure black for every theme color and for "Use system colors": window, cards and lists become #000000, while dialogs and menus stay near-black so they remain visible.

patches.name: AMOLED Dark Theme
patches.description: Flattens dark theme backgrounds (window, cards, dialogs, toolbar, navigation bar, search, calendar) to pure black instead of the stock dark-gray shades.

patches.name: AMOLED dark mode
patches.description: Unlocks AliExpress' built-in dark mode on every device (Redmi/Xiaomi/POCO are blacklisted by the app), turns it on by default so the app follows the system theme (it can still be switched off in Settings > Dark mode), and makes dark backgrounds pure black.

patches.name: Assume device is online
patches.description: Fixes "Something went wrong, please try again…" when pairing with the browser extension. StayFree gates all sync behind a precheck that must reach Google and that also refuses to sync while usage-data collection is opted out; local pairing is served from the phone itself and needs neither, so report the device as free to sync.

patches.name: Bypass License Check
patches.description: Stubs the Google Play Automatic Integrity Protection (pairip) signature and license checks, which otherwise detect the re-signed APK on launch and send the user to the app's Play Store page instead of opening the app.

patches.name: Deactivate Firebase Analytics
patches.description: Deactivates Firebase Analytics and removes its associated broadcast receivers and services.

patches.name: Deactivate Firebase Crashlytics
patches.description: Deactivates Firebase Crashlytics crash reporting and removes associated services.

patches.name: Deactivate Firebase Performance Monitoring
patches.description: Deactivates the collection of performance data on app startup time, network requests, and other related metrics.

patches.name: Deactivate Firebase Telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase/Google Analytics collection, Crashlytics crash reporting and session tracking via manifest flags, strips the App Measurement services and receiver, and removes the advertising-ID permission. App functionality (prayer times, push notifications) is unaffected.

patches.name: Debug QR pairing path
patches.description: Diagnostic only. Records why StayFree's QR pairing does or does not issue its pairing request — the two guards on the scanned code, and the device-group status the pairing coroutine checks before it reaches the network — to the same log as "Local device sync". Leave this off unless you are debugging a pairing failure.

patches.name: Disable All Telemetry
patches.description: Disables all analytics and telemetry: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Sessions, Installations and Transport auto-registration, and the AdServices / Advertising ID attribution surface.

patches.name: Disable All Telemetry
patches.description: Disables all analytics and telemetry including Firebase, Google Analytics, Facebook, and Google Ads tracking. This is a comprehensive privacy patch that removes all data collection.

patches.name: Disable All Telemetry
patches.description: Disables all analytics and telemetry: Firebase Analytics, Installations and Transport auto-registration, the Google Measurement and DataTransport upload services, and the AdServices / Advertising ID attribution surface.

patches.name: Disable All Telemetry
patches.description: Comprehensive privacy patch: disables the OpenSignal and CellRebel data-collection SDKs and deactivates Firebase/Google Analytics, Crashlytics and session tracking. Does not affect app functionality.

patches.name: Disable All Telemetry
patches.description: Comprehensive privacy patch: silences the Ookla DevMetrics dispatcher so no event reaches Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics or Logcat. Does not affect speed-test functionality.

patches.name: Disable All Telemetry
patches.description: Removes and blocks all telemetry and analytics: SensorTower usage-data upload (app/web usage, browsing, shopping, AI prompts), Amplitude, Singular, Bugsnag, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics/Performance/Sessions, Google App Measurement, Facebook app events and the advertising ID. Telemetry endpoints are also rewritten to localhost.

patches.name: Disable App Rating Prompt
patches.description: Removes the Play In-App Review ("rate this app") prompt launched from MainActivity.onCreate, so the review dialog is never requested.

patches.name: Disable Facebook Ads Tracking
patches.description: Disables Facebook Audience Network ad tracking and telemetry.

patches.name: Disable Facebook Analytics
patches.description: Disables Facebook App Events tracking and analytics.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Messaging Analytics
patches.description: Disables Firebase Cloud Messaging analytics and notification tracking.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Sessions
patches.description: Disables Firebase Sessions tracking and telemetry.

patches.name: Disable Google Ads Tracking
patches.description: Disables Google AdMob tracking and impression reporting.

patches.name: Disable Logging (Analytics)
patches.description: Stops Speedtest by Ookla's DevMetrics dispatcher (com.ookla.tools.logging) from forwarding info/watch/alarm events to Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Logcat.

patches.name: Disable Partner Data-Collection SDKs
patches.description: Disables the bundled OpenSignal and CellRebel network-measurement SDKs, which collect location, cell and network telemetry in the background. Forces each wrapper's eligibility check to return false so the SDKs never initialize. Also strips their background components from the manifest.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops the Alibaba UT analytics SDK from attaching global properties and your account identity (nick, user id, open id) to tracked events.

patches.name: Disable forced updates
patches.description: Stops the automatic "new version available" and forced update dialogs.

patches.name: Disable promotions notifications
patches.description: Drops promotional push notifications (deals, campaigns, wishlist price drops, trends). Order status and message notifications still come through.

patches.name: Disable splash screen
patches.description: Skips the full-screen splash advertisement shown on app launch.

patches.name: Enable image saving
patches.description: Always shows the Save button in the full-screen product and review image viewer.

patches.name: Fill Adaptive Icon
patches.description: Scales the launcher adaptive icon foreground to fill the whole icon shape, removing the empty padding around it.

patches.name: Fix MIUI permission check crash
patches.description: Stops the Xiaomi/Redmi/Poco "background pop-up" permission check from crashing on AOSP-based ROMs ("Bad operation #10021"), which otherwise aborts device pairing with "Something went wrong".

patches.name: Force hasSystemFeature true (narrow)
patches.description: Return true from public static boolean methods calling PackageManager.hasSystemFeature with a String arg. Narrow-scoped to avoid lifecycle callbacks.

patches.name: Hide Google sign-in in Paired Devices
patches.description: Hides the "Sign in with Google" button from the Paired Devices section in settings. Pairing with a code still works.

patches.name: Hide Privacy Policy Link
patches.description: Removes the "Privacy Policy" link from the About section of the Settings screen.

patches.name: Hide Remove Ads Button
patches.description: Removes the "Remove Ads" entry from the main overflow menu and the "Remove Ads" / "Donate" button from the About screen.

patches.name: Hide Support Us Section
patches.description: Removes the "Support Us" preference category (Rate Us, Donate / Remove Ads) from the Settings screen.

patches.name: Hide texts
patches.description: Hides the instruction text on the "Pair with code" screen: "Select the app you want to pair your Android app with:".

patches.name: Ignore Remote-Config Overrides
patches.description: Severs the Flagsmith remote-override channel by forcing the remote-config delegate to always resolve to the Firebase provider (which uses the app's bundled defaults). Server-side flags can no longer be flipped on against a patched build. Config reads keep working normally.

patches.name: In-app QR scanner
patches.description: Scans the browser extension's pairing QR code inside StayFree, like Brave's built-in scanner, instead of asking you to open the camera app (whose link can't open a patched app). Opens on its own when you choose to pair with a browser extension or the desktop app, and from a "Scan QR code" shortcut on the app icon. Uses ZXing, so it works without Google Play Services.

patches.name: Local data backup
patches.description: Replaces the Google Drive "Usage Data Backup" in Settings > Storage with a local backup: export your usage history, limits and settings to a zip file you pick, and restore them from one. Needs no Google account and no longer asks you to opt in to data collection.

patches.name: Local device sync
patches.description: Pairs the phone with the StayFree browser extension over your local network without data collection. The app runs a small sync server on port 8787 and serves its usage straight from Android, so nothing goes to StayFree/SensorTower. Removes the "Anonymous data collection must be enabled to pair devices" prompt. Needs the patched browser extension.

patches.name: Neutralize Signature Check
patches.description: Stubs the hidden anti-tamper check in LanguageCheckerKt that MD5-fingerprints the signing certificate and calls System.exit(0) when it does not match the bundled signature. A re-signed (patched) APK always mismatches, so without this the app kills itself on launch and no other patch can run. Required dependency of every other Salaat patch.

patches.name: Refresh paired devices list
patches.description: Fixes Settings > Paired Devices staying empty after a device pairs successfully. StayFree reloads the device list and announces it on a flow that nothing observes, while the screen waits on a flow that nothing ever updates, so it never recomposes. Announce the reload on the flow the screen actually watches.

patches.name: Remove AdServices Attribution
patches.description: Removes the ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION / ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID permissions and the android.ext.adservices uses-library entry, so the Privacy Sandbox AdServices APIs are never touched.

patches.name: Remove AdServices Attribution
patches.description: Removes the ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION / ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID permissions and the android.ext.adservices uses-library entry, so the Privacy Sandbox AdServices APIs are never touched.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Stubs out AdsManager so no banner/native ads or consent dialogs are ever loaded, requested, or shown, and the Mobile Ads SDK is never initialized.

patches.name: Remove Advertising ID
patches.description: Removes the Google Play Services Advertising ID permission.

patches.name: Remove Advertising ID
patches.description: Removes the Google Play Services Advertising ID permission.

patches.name: Remove All Ads
patches.description: Turns on the app's own ad-free flag so no native or interstitial ad is ever requested or shown on any screen (dashboard, Wi-Fi/app analyzer, sensors, battery, memory, tools, or automatic tests), which also hides the "Remove ads" promo cards, and removes the Facebook Audience Network mediation SDK's auto-initializing ContentProvider so it never starts.

patches.name: Remove Analytics Services
patches.description: Removes the Google Measurement and DataTransport services and receivers that upload analytics events, so no scheduled job or alarm can wake the app to send telemetry.

patches.name: Remove App Info contents
patches.description: Keeps the "App Info" row with the version number in Settings, but it no longer opens the App Info screen: Debug Usage Limit Problems, Data Privacy, StayFree Community, Support us, Credits & Open source libraries and the support App ID are gone. They are also removed from the settings search.

patches.name: Remove Donate Screen
patches.description: Removes every way into the Donate screen (Settings "Donate (Remove Ads)", the overflow-menu and About-screen "Remove Ads" buttons) and makes the screen close itself immediately if anything still opens it.

patches.name: Remove Facebook Audience Network Initialization
patches.description: Removes the manifest-declared ContentProvider that auto-initializes the Facebook Audience Network mediation SDK on every app start.

patches.name: Remove Firebase Component Discovery
patches.description: Removes the Firebase ComponentDiscoveryService, which is how Analytics, Crashlytics, Sessions, Installations, and Transport auto-register themselves on startup.

patches.name: Remove Firebase Component Discovery
patches.description: Removes the Firebase ComponentDiscoveryService and FirebaseInitProvider, which is how Analytics and Installations auto-register themselves on startup.

patches.name: Remove Follow us
patches.description: Removes the "• Follow us!" link next to "StayFree" at the top of the side menu. Tapping the header no longer opens StayFree's social media page.

patches.name: Remove Get Help
patches.description: Removes the "Get Help" row (HelpScout support chat) from Settings and from the settings search.

patches.name: Remove Google login request
patches.description: Removes the "Sign in with Google" page from onboarding and the "Create StayFree profile" step from the home setup checklist. Signing in manually from the drawer/pairing screens still works.

patches.name: Remove Inbox Control
patches.description: Removes the Inbox Control (Gmail cleaner) feature: its drawer entry, its permissions section and every screen that opens it. The Neon theme and custom app icons that were locked behind signing up for it are unlocked, and the Gmail sign-in no longer keeps the permission setup reminder on the home screen.

patches.name: Remove My Friends
patches.description: Removes "My Friends" (usage sharing with friends through StayFree's servers) from the side menu and from the settings search.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Blocks the marketing pop-up layers (campaign interstitials, coupon and gift overlays) shown over the home page, product pages and search.

patches.name: Remove affiliate tracking
patches.description: Disables the Firebase Analytics events AliExpress logs for attribution and affiliate/marketing tracking.

patches.name: Remove coupons popup
patches.description: Hides the coupon floor/popup shown over search results.

patches.name: Remove data collection opt-out
patches.description: Removes the "Opt-Out of Data Collection" switch from Settings > Data Privacy and locks data collection off: the opt-out can no longer be undone (the "Opt-In" buttons do nothing) and the opt-out status is never reported to StayFree. Includes "Disable All Telemetry".

patches.name: Remove drawer sign-in
patches.description: Removes the "Sign into StayFree" account row from the bottom of the side menu.

patches.name: Remove pair devices banner
patches.description: Removes the "Tap to pair your devices for the best StayFree experience!" banner from the dashboard and the "Cross Platform is here" sheet it opens (Google login on each device, "Share Download Links").

patches.name: Remove sponsored items from search
patches.description: Removes sponsored (AD) products from search results.

patches.name: Spoof Pixel model check (narrow)
patches.description: In-APK utility methods checking Pixel model return true. Narrow-scoped to avoid lifecycle callbacks.

patches.name: Spoof client (Infinity)
patches.description: Replaces the bundled Reddit OAuth credentials with your own, so the app keeps working after Reddit's API changes. Requires a client ID from https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps (create an 'installed app').

options.title: OAuth client ID
options.description: The Reddit OAuth client ID of an 'installed app' created at https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps.

options.title: Redirect URI
options.description: The redirect URI configured on your Reddit app. Must match exactly. Leave as-is unless you entered something different on Reddit.

options.title: User agent
options.description: The user agent sent to Reddit. Leave blank to keep the app's own user agent, which is the safest choice.

patches.name: Strip root detection (narrow)
patches.description: Force public static boolean methods referencing "Magisk" to return false. Narrow-scoped.

patches.name: Unlock Ad-Free
patches.description: Removes ads and unlocks ad-free status in Speedtest by Ookla.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Windy Premium UI and features client-side by patching the JS bundle (store default 'premium', hasAny()=true, clearTier() neutralised, subs-premium body class) and forces the widgets' native premium check to true. Server-side premium data still requires a real subscription. Note: the map needs WebGL — it stays gray on WebViews that block WebGL (e.g. Cromite SystemWebView).

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks all pro features without a purchase.

patches.name: Unlock Pro (Masareef)
patches.description: Makes UserDataManager.isSubscribed() always return true, unlocking all Pro features.

patches.name: Unlock all premium features
patches.description: Unlocks every theme (gamification-level, Black and Neon themes) and all custom app icons without earning levels, pairing a device or signing up for Inbox Control.
